incomplete_fix_quote: The fix for CVE-2026-27598 (commit e2ed589, PR #1691) added ValidateDAGName to CreateNewDAG and rewrote generateFilePath to use filepath.Base. This patched the CREATE path. The remaining API endpoints - GET, DELETE, RENAME, EXECUTE - all pass the {fileName} URL path parameter to locateDAG without calling ValidateDAGName. /-encoded forward slashes in the {fileName} segment traverse outside the DAGs directory.
root_cause: internal/persis/filedag/store.go locateDAG(): the `strings.Contains(nameOrPath, filepath.Separator)` branch calls findDAGFile() which resolves with filepath.Abs and checks only existence + YAML extension, with NO containment against baseDir. The GET/DELETE/RENAME/EXECUTE handlers (internal/service/frontend/api/v1/dags.go) pass the decoded {fileName} path param straight to it. chi captures %2F-encoded slashes as one segment; oapi-codegen url.PathUnescape decodes them; dagu binds chi directly to http.Server so no ServeMux path-cleaning fires.

honest_finding: Genuine incomplete-fix, but NOT expressible under the read-exfil 3-check differential gate. The 27598 fix guards the WRITE (create) verb; the 33344 residual is on the READ verb, which the 27598 fix never touched (reads behave identically on V0 and V1). Seed (write) and residual (read) cannot share one read-exfil flag channel, so original_poc_reaches_flag_on_v0 is structurally false. This is the 'unguarded-sibling-endpoint' family, not the 'same-sink encoding-bypass' family the differential oracle targets.
